title: Mochiichao status condition record (#27)
description: One record per status condition. Architecture follows the publicly documented two-class split (persistent/volatile). ALL condition names and numeric values are OPEN in canon — the schema fixes the shape only. Unknowns are null and flagged in status, never invented (core data convention).

conditionId.description: Stable internal key (kebab). Never renamed; display names change, ids do not.

displayName.description: OPEN for the entire roster — canon names no Mochiichao conditions yet.

class.description: Persistent: max one per creature, survives battle (exclusivity enforced by the battle layer). Volatile: stackable, battle-scoped.

value.description: Null until a canon/balance source sets it.

statStages.description: Stat ids affected; magnitude lives in the battle system's stage table, not here.

cureBy.description: Item ids (joins item layer #31). Every id must resolve to an item with effect.system=status.

glyphId.description: Native glyph art id; art lands with the HUD build.

colourSlot.description: One hue per condition. Never ink #101010, never alert red #a03436 (canon-reserved).

tag.description: 3-letter text fallback shown at medium+ sizes; localisable data, not art.

animscriptHooks.description: Cue names consumed by the move-animscript format (#9) target_fx/screen tracks.

status.description: Provenance per core convention; 'OPEN — roster not locked in canon' until an owner/balance pass.
